text_block_list.text:
And so, the first three years walked 
alongside Mejiro Ryan came to an end.

Still, the Twinkle Series continues on. 
The next goal is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how was my lap time on that last 
lap?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Looks like the new plank exercise 
is already showing results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, going smoothly!! At this rate, 
our next goal is—

Mejiro Ryan, conqueror of both major Grand 
Prix races in the same year. We asked her 
about her next dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, do you want to know? Though, you 
might be a little surprised, you know?
choice_data_list: Is it that big of a dream?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's a big deal or not, 
but it is a little surprising.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"After conquering the two major Grand 
Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen and Arima 
Kinen, the next goal is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a new record time for the 2200m turf 
race!!

Breaking the course record... That's a 
completely different kind of goal from 
what I've had before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've been doing a lot of thinking. About 
what truly lies at my core.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it really comes down to speed. 
You train, clock a great time, win, and 
get praised for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because I can run fast that 
people treat me like a star!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If I lose that, I'm back to zero. I don't 
ever want to forget what matters most."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why we aim for record time! Daily 
strength training, core conditioning! 
Pushing 0.1 seconds ahead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I plan to keep going for a long time.

Mejiro Ryan seemed to have changed, yet 
she remained the same.

"No matter your state of mind, never stop 
training. Being able to do that is 
probably a person's greatest strength."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eheheheh, look at this home stretch! 
Straight as far as the eye can see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna give it my all next time too!! 
Faster than anyone else, and feeling 
better than anyone else!!"

Mejiro Ryan keeps running. As a 
lightning-fast athlete.

I will continue to support that 
refreshing, completely unclouded dream of 
hers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and romance too! I want some of that. 
ASAP.

"Aside from racing... it seemed she had 
another dream."
